thread:
taylor: Kicking off RC for routing tiebreaker behavior change. Target artifact: rr-router:v0.28-rc1. Quiet window requested 02:00-04:00 PT. Planning a feature-flagged canary.

deploy-bot: Build passed for commit abc1234 (artifact: rr-router:v0.28-rc1). Image pushed to registry. CI green.

lee: ran unit + smoke in staging. small test flake fixed on branch; staging smoke looks good.

riley: created feature flag `routing_tiebreaker_v2`. Will toggle during canary only.

taylor: rollout plan: enable flag at 5% -> wait 10m -> 30% -> wait 10m -> 100%. Metric stop conditions: 5xx > 0.5%, p99 > baseline*2, or error budget burn > 10% in 10m.

pat: I'm oncall for the window. I'll wire alerts and be ready to trigger rollback if thresholds hit.

taylor: locking artifact in registry now: `registry lock rr-router:v0.28-rc1 --by taylor --reason \"RC for routing tie-breaker\"`

deploy-bot: Artifact rr-router:v0.28-rc1 locked by taylor at 2026-03-22T03:02:07Z.

riley: no DB migration, just config toggle. Flag flip CLI: `infra-flag set routing_tiebreaker_v2 on --scope canary --tag rr-router:v0.28-rc1`

lee: starting canary (5%) — enabling flag for canary cohort now.

oncall: seeing a tiny routing skew on first minute, p50 stable, p99 +12% but within threshold. No increase in 5xx.

riley: good to ramp. Warming query cache with recent traces to avoid cold miss storms: `./tools/replay_recent_requests --service router --duration 3m`

lee: ramped to 30%. monitoring dashboards pinned in #eng-sre and alerting to this thread.

deploy-bot: Auto-promotion to 100% scheduled in 20m if no guardrail trip. Rollback command: `rr-rollback --to-tag rr-router:v0.27-stable --reason <alert-id>` (see runbook: https://go/runbooks/rr-rollback).

pat: dashboards look green. minor log spam about `tiebreaker: absent-metric-name` in debug logs — non-blocking, will file ticket.

taylor: noted. If log spam increases by >1000/min we treat as a noisy regression and pause ramp.

lee: no objections, QA signed off +1.

riley: infra/CICD +1, feature flag scoped correctly.

taylor: if no objections by +15m I will approve full promotion and merge RC tag to release channel. :rocket:

oncall: no objections, standing by.

deploy-bot: Promotion executed: rr-router:v0.28-rc1 -> serving. Traffic at 100%. Post-promote smoke: 2xx rates steady, 5xx = 0.0%, p99 within baseline.

lee: small follow-up: open ticket RR-1428 to rename metric to `tiebreaker_choice` to reduce debug noise.

taylor: RC promoted and closed. Release notes draft: \"routing tie-breaker improved to prefer lower-cost shard on tie; reduces oscillations for multi-model fanout.\" @riley please finalize wording. :tada:
